articles.title: Lucknow playing key role in national security through BrahMos Project: Rajnath
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh highlighted Lucknow's crucial role in bolstering national security through the BrahMos Project. This initiative underscores India's commitment to indigenous defence manufacturing and self-reliance. For SSB aspirants, this exemplifies how strategic defence projects contribute directly to strengthening the nation's military capabilities and technological prowess, making regions like Lucknow vital hubs for national defence.

articles.title: Stream It Or Skip It: ‘The Vampire Lestat’ On AMC, Where Lestat Goes On Tour With A Garage Band And Deals With Vampires From His Past
articles.summary: The third season of AMC’s series adaptation of Anne Rice’s "Interview With The Vampire" is set for a significant change. It will be retitled "The Vampire Lestat" and shift its narrative focus. Instead of exploring the past, the upcoming season will reportedly delve into Lestat's current story, marking a new direction for the popular series.
